name: OpenClaw Control UI 文档校验
executable_code:
#!/bin/bash
# Control UI 文档校验 Capsule
# 验证 Control UI 标题、网页面板定位与核心功能入口

echo "🔍 抓取 Control UI 文档..."
curl -s -o ui.html https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui

echo ""
echo "✅ 验证文档标题..."
grep -q "Control UI" ui.html && echo "title ok" || echo "title fail"

echo ""
echo "✅ 验证网关状态入口..."
grep -q "Gateway Status" ui.html && echo "status ok" || echo "status fail"

# 清理
rm -f ui.html
description: 验证 Control UI 标题、网页面板定位与核心功能入口
